faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: What people usually ask before getting started.

card.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
card.a: No. The free plan is created instantly — no card, and no trial that silently expires.

clientAccount.q: Does my client need an account to view the proposal?
clientAccount.a: No. You send a public link and they open the proposal right in the browser, on mobile or desktop, and can approve it in one click.

mobile.a: Yes. Orca works in the mobile browser and can be installed as an app (PWA) with an icon on your home screen.

limit.q: What happens when I hit the free plan limit?
limit.a: Nothing is deleted. Your proposals and clients stay accessible; you just can't create new ones until you free up space or subscribe to Premium.

pix.a: You add your payment key and the proposal shows a QR code so the client pays you directly. Orca never holds your money and takes no commission.
